newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian manufactures prices rise in Aug.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian manufactures prices rise in Aug.

text.p: Australian manufacturing output prices rose 0.2 percent in August from the previous month and were unchanged from a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
"Higher prices for basic metals and meat were partly offset by lower prices for refined petroleum and motor vehicles and parts," the bureau said.
At zero, the annual rate of manufacturing output inflation is now higher than July's minus 0.2 percent. But it remains lower than any rate recorded over the past year.
In August 1995, the annual rate of price rises for manufactures was 4.1 percent.
